scientific_integrity: Proof based on integer incidence identities, a unimodular minor, determinant expansion, and character orthogonality; two standalone exact checkers. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact ideal pure graph states on a fixed thirty-vertex incidence geometry, one full natural bipartition, and five specified omitted gates. Earlier equivalent integral-minor computations remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Five omitted incidence gates restore maximal bipartite entanglement on the Tutte–Coxeter graph
